text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had called Narita Brian over
to hand her some fan letters, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If you don't need anything else, I'm heading back.
choice_data_list: You're not going to read it?
Aren't you going to read it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
This is a letter addressed to me.
What I do with it is my own business, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Please, just don't throw it out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wha--!? As if I'd ever do something like that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... I won't read it here.
That's what it means.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way she would throw away
letters from her fans..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian walked away brusquely.
However, she treasured the fan letter,
tucking it carefully into her jacket.
